summary: TheBarcode 1.12.7: production health checks, resilient offline synchronization and native upgrades.
notes: Owner and manager-assigned permissions now authorize reports, audit, accounting, approvals, expenses and inventory independently of base staff roles.
Demo and live institution data remain strictly isolated across dashboards, bills, expenses, reports, insights and notifications.
Accounting journals, trial balance, financial position and operational corrections reconcile from live transactions.
Purchasing, stocktakes, lot-aware wastage and production runs update inventory, weighted cost, accounting and audit history transactionally.
Held bills support revisions, new products, approval workflows, cash or M-Pesa posting and explicit unpaid, paid or credit receipts.
Expenses support submission, approval, editing, payments, archival and authoritative notification clearing.
TheBarcode branding, theme-aware transparent artwork and Beyond Raw Data publisher identity are included in the installer.
The installer preserves the institution database, bundles WebView2 and the verified Xprinter driver, and creates the local server and print bridge.
PostgreSQL 18.6 is bundled and installed silently when no PostgreSQL service is detected; existing PostgreSQL credentials and data are preserved.
Font scaling, responsive touch layouts, full-screen mode, collapsible navigation and global grid search/sorting are included.
Production hardening adds live and database readiness checks, bounded API timeouts and backoff for offline synchronization retries.
